RIDER: We looked at your cancellation dispute and the outcome is: no refund, so the $6.61 cancellation fee stands.

What decided it: our records show the driver arrived at the pickup spot, stayed within the pickup area for more than three minutes, and only cancelled after that wait. You said you came out a minute after the cancellation, which is a bit later than the driver's waiting period.

There is no voucher to issue here. If you think something in the pickup details was wrong, reply and we'll take another look at your account.

DRIVER: Good news on your cancellation dispute: it's resolved in your favour, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is kept and paid to you as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: our records show you tapped that you'd arrived, were within the pickup area at the time, and stayed there more than three minutes before cancelling. That meets the waiting requirement for a no-show fee.

No further action is needed from you. Your account stays in good standing under this decision.
